title: Series 的三要素与 DataFrame 的列导向结构
expected_output:
=== Series 是「values + index + name」三件套 ===
  values = [10, 20, 30]  dtype: int64
  index  = ['a', 'b', 'c']
  name   = price
  s.dtype = int64 （就是 values 的 dtype）

=== 混类型会把整列升成 object，向量化随之失效 ===
  pd.Series([1, 'two', 3.0]).dtype = object
  对 object 列求和: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'int' and 'str'

=== DataFrame 是「共享行索引的列字典」：每列独立 dtype ===
       city  price  qty     ok
apple    BJ    3.5   10   True
banana   SH    1.2   25  False
cherry   GZ    8.0    4   True

  dtypes:
    city     str
    price    float64
    qty      int64
    ok       bool

=== 取列返回 Series；取一行也返回 Series（跨列，所以会升类型）===
  df['price'] -> Series | dtype: float64
  df.loc['apple'] -> Series | dtype: object  <- 混了字符串与数值

=== 从 ndarray 构造必须显式给 columns，否则列名是整数 ===
  pd.DataFrame(arr).columns = [0, 1]   <- 整数，不是字符串
  显式指定后 columns      = ['a', 'b']
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

s = pd.Series([10, 20, 30], index=["a", "b", "c"], name="price")
print("=== Series 是「values + index + name」三件套 ===")
print("  values =", s.values.tolist(), " dtype:", s.values.dtype)
print("  index  =", list(s.index))
print("  name   =", s.name)
print("  s.dtype =", s.dtype, "（就是 values 的 dtype）")

print()
print("=== 混类型会把整列升成 object，向量化随之失效 ===")
mixed = pd.Series([1, "two", 3.0])
print("  pd.Series([1, 'two', 3.0]).dtype =", mixed.dtype)
print("  对 object 列求和:", end=" ")
try:
    print(mixed.sum())
except TypeError as e:
    print("TypeError:", str(e)[:60])

print()
print("=== DataFrame 是「共享行索引的列字典」：每列独立 dtype ===")
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "city": ["BJ", "SH", "GZ"],
    "price": [3.5, 1.2, 8.0],
    "qty": [10, 25, 4],
    "ok": [True, False, True],
}, index=["apple", "banana", "cherry"])
print(df.to_string())
print()
print("  dtypes:")
for col, dt in df.dtypes.items():
    print("    %-8s %s" % (col, dt))

print()
print("=== 取列返回 Series；取一行也返回 Series（跨列，所以会升类型）===")
print("  df['price'] ->", type(df["price"]).__name__, "| dtype:", df["price"].dtype)
row = df.loc["apple"]
print("  df.loc['apple'] ->", type(row).__name__, "| dtype:", row.dtype, " <- 混了字符串与数值")

print()
print("=== 从 ndarray 构造必须显式给 columns，否则列名是整数 ===")
arr = np.arange(6).reshape(3, 2)
print("  pd.DataFrame(arr).columns =", list(pd.DataFrame(arr).columns), "  <- 整数，不是字符串")
print("  显式指定后 columns      =", list(pd.DataFrame(arr, columns=["a", "b"]).columns))
